newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fire will not badly hit Eurotunnel results - Malpas.
newsitem.headline: Fire will not badly hit Eurotunnel results - Malpas.

text.p: Financial results for Channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA/Plc will not be badly affected by a fire which damaged a part of the fixed link last November, co-chairman Robert Malpas confirmed on Thursday.
"The 1997 financial results will not be too severely affected by the fire," Malpas told a news conference at the French tunnel terminal.
He said that the company was covered by insurance for "direct loss and our consequential loss" and would have to pay excesses of between seven to 10 million stg.

"We are covered by insurance...and the insurance is covering our direct loss and our consequential loss, and apart from the excess which we have talked to you about before, which is of the order of seven to 10 million pounds, we expect the 1997 financial results would not be too severely affected by the fire," he said.
A fire broke out on November 18 on a truck which was on a Eurotunnel shuttle wagon travelling to France from England. The damage closed down a part of the tunnel, halving tunnel capacity.
